interpretation.combined_pre_evidence_pool_cap: A source-level candidate-generation cap only; it is not a claim that 60 candidates can receive evidence analysis.
interpretation.direct_content_probe_pool_per_query: Six leaves room for the one transient viewer failure observed among eight public direct attempts and excludes credential-limited Kaggle sampling.
interpretation.sample_soft_byte_budget_per_dataset: A conservative future default; the largest successful M0 retained response was 22898 bytes. The 64 MiB protocol cap remains a safety limit, not a target.
interpretation.provisional_m1_process_memory_ceiling_by: A 128 MiB operational ceiling derived with headroom above the 37,994,496-byte M0 peak. It must be revalidated when M1 adds parsing/caching logic.
interpretation.maximum_direct_content_path_failure_rate: Sources above 20% direct-path failure remain metadata-only until a documented, permitted access path is established.
